words.sense: Violate an accepted moral, social, or legal limit.
misconceptions: Confused with trespass when the defining clue is overlooked.

words.sense: Enter another person’s property without permission.
misconceptions: Confused with transgress when the defining clue is overlooked.

semantic_axes.description: Transgress means breach a rule of conduct; trespass specifically means enter someone else’s property without permission.

edges.boundary_rule: Transgress means breach a rule of conduct; trespass specifically means enter someone else’s property without permission.
clues_a: Breaks a rule or boundary of conduct.
Violate an accepted moral, social, or legal limit.
clues_b: Crosses a property boundary without consent.
Enter another person’s property without permission.
irrelevant_clues: format, colour, or popularity unless they establish the boundary
location or timing that does not change the decisive feature

misconceptions.M1: Treating transgress as though it always means trespass.
misconceptions.M2: Treating trespass as though it always means transgress.
misconceptions.M3: Overvaluing a distracting detail instead of the decisive semantic distinction.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Aisha’s sharing of private messages?

beats.text: Aisha forwarded her friend’s private messages to others after promising to keep them secret.
beats.decisive_clue: she broke an explicit promise of confidentiality
beats.reason: This establishes that she broke an explicit promise of confidentiality.

beats.text: She sent them into a group chat with hundreds of members.
beats.decisive_clue: she broke an explicit promise of confidentiality
beats.reason: The wider audience increases the breach; the action concerns trust, not entering land.

chains.feedback_short: She broke an explicit promise of confidentiality; that detail favors transgress.
chains.feedback_deep: The wider audience increases the breach; the action concerns trust, not entering land. Transgress means breach a rule of conduct; trespass specifically means enter someone else’s property without permission.
chains.contrast_rule: Transgress crosses a rule; trespass crosses a property line.

hints.attention: Ask what kind of boundary she crossed.

hints.contrast: Transgress crosses a rule; trespass crosses a property line.
